correctness.rationale: Complete rank-two game reduction to rooted two-element multiplication diagrams. For PSL_2, classical cyclic maximal-torus orders and regular semisimple centralizers give the exact 4/6/8 and nonsquareable-high-order flags; the small-field S_3 and A_4 cases are distinct. Explicit prime-power representatives attain all ten classes, and the q=47 bound follows from the first simultaneous order-6 and order-8 field. Exact diagram enumeration of seventeen groups agrees with the symbolic criterion, without serving as an infinite certificate.

value.rationale: It gives the complete ordinary bounded-depth logical quotient for a classical natural simple-group family and a sharp finite representative bound of 51,888. Rooted square availability at order ≥5 proves that low-rank logic sees more than the 4/6/8 element-order spectrum. All ten classes and arithmetic congruence thresholds are motivated by shallow group expressivity, not an arbitrary bounded computational slice.
